## 1. Enroll the first Asset

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json

  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json

  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<asset>",

  "kind": "asset",

  "subtype": "ground vehicle",

      "latitude": 42.2743,
      "longitude": -71.8081
    },
    "health": {
      "battery_percent": 75
    }
  },

    {
      "command_id": "move_to",

}
```

      }

    "id": "<asset>",

}
